lead: Bound host pinned staging and stream complete-node transfer groups serially
accepted_source_facts: Constructor allocates cached page-locked max(plan.arena_elements)float words before uploads.
Fresh zero compressed uploads do not need the staging image, but final full readback reuses it.
Warm compressed uploads currently decode a whole arena into staging. Compact inactive snapshots and full/F32 layouts need exact preservation.
Per-node quantization needs each full node vector to retain its original scale/encoding.
distinct_hypothesis: Reduce actual pinned allocation size and use one serial bounded staging window for complete-node uploads/readbacks. Unlike closedE040, no two-window overlap/pipeline/work scheduling variation. This needs separate admission and must not compose or tune E040.
risks: More DMA submissions/stream waits and transfer descriptors may erase allocation/cache benefits.
Extra persistent metadata and all-thread CPU cost must be measured.
Accepted E080 overlaps existing allocation/setup with zero checks, so isolated allocation spans are not removable complete-cycle headroom.
Warm/F32/full/compact/inactive/materialization/state/error paths require full exact control; no fresh-zero-only fixture exemption.
next_action: Audit closed history and existing transfer layout for a distinct fixed bounded-allocation form; freeze source/equivalence/component and actual material gates before any implementation/native process. No candidate/source/timing exists here.
limits: Retained actual geometry and current source facts only; no predicted gain, current headroom, tested bounded allocation or performance result.
